This FloPlast 110mm grey uPVC 135° double socket top offset bend is a robust drainage pipe fitting for soil and vent systems. Its lightweight construction from durable uPVC ensures long-lasting performance in various installations, making it ideal for a range of plumbing projects. The bend allows for push-fit and solvent weld connections, offering versatility and ease of installation for trade professionals. It effectively handles high temperature waste discharges and benefits from simple jointing when silicone lubricant is applied to the seals.
